instruction.text: Look at the thermometer and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Which temperature is shown on the thermometer?

atoms.sound: What is 10 degrees Celsius colder than 10 degrees Celsius?
What is 20 degrees Celsius colder than 10 degrees Celsius?

instruction.text: Look at the thermometer and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Which temperature is shown on the thermometer?

atoms.sound: What is 20 degrees Celsius colder than 0 degrees Celsius?
What is 10 degrees Celsius colder than 20 degrees Celsius?

text: Use the thermometer to help count with negative numbers.

atoms.a: When Jack went to bed, the temperature was <mat>1`°C`</mat>. It dropped by <mat>3`°C`</mat> overnight. What was the temperature in the morning?
atoms.sound: When Jack went to bed, the temperature was 1 degree Celsius. It dropped by 3 degrees Celsius overnight. What was the temperature in the morning?

atoms.a: Susie is setting up her new freezer. When she first plugs it in, the temperature is <mat>5`°C`</mat>. After 5 hours, it drops by <mat>10`°C`</mat>. What is the new temperature?
atoms.sound: Susie is setting up her new freezer. When she first plugs it in, the temperature is 5 degrees Celsius. After 5 hours, it drops by 10 degrees Celsius. What is the new temperature?

atoms.a: Taylor buys some ice cream from the supermarket. The temperature of the ice cream is <mat>3`°C`</mat> before they put it in the freezer. It drops by <mat>4`°C`</mat> over the next hour. What is the temperature of the ice cream now?
atoms.sound: Taylor buys some ice cream from the supermarket. The temperature of the ice cream is 3 degrees Celsius before they put it in the freezer. It drops by 4 degrees Celsius over the next hour. What is the temperature of the ice cream now?

atoms.a: Before the restaurant closes, the temperature of the fridge is <mat>5`°C`</mat>. Due to a technical fault, the temperature decreases by <mat>15`°C`</mat> overnight. What is the temperature of the fridge in the morning?
atoms.sound: Before the restaurant closes, the temperature of the fridge is 5 degrees Celsius. Due to a technical fault, the temperature decreases by 15 degrees Celsius overnight. What is the temperature of the fridge in the morning?

atoms.a: At 11pm, the temperature is <mat>0`°C`</mat>. By 3am, the temperature had dropped by <mat>20`°C`</mat>. What is the temperature at 3am?
atoms.sound: At 11pm, the temperature is 0 degrees Celsius. By 3am, the temperature had dropped by 20 degrees Celsius. What is the temperature at 3am?

atoms.a: The local town has just set up an ice rink. The temperature of the ice is −10°C, but needs to drop by <mat>5`°C`</mat> before it can be used. What temperature should the ice rink be?
atoms.sound: The local town has just set up an ice rink. The temperature of the rink is minus 10 degrees Celsius, but needs to drop by 5 degrees Celsius before it can be used. What temperature should the ice rink be?
